 ...RESPONDENTS  THIS MISCELLANEOUS SECOND APPEAL IS FIELD UNDER SECTION 54(1) OF THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT PRAYING TO MODIFY THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 10-10-2011 PASSED IN LAC NO.91/2010 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE, HOLENARASIPURA AND JUDGMENT AND AWARD PASSED IN LAC APPEAL NO 25/2020 DATED 15-02-2022 ON THE FILE OF V ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS COURT AT HASSAN BY ENHANCE THE COMPENSATION WITH INTEREST AND OTHER STATUTORY BENEFITS IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

Since matter was listed for non-compliance of office objections for 6th time, as a final opportunity,
appellant was permitted to comply with office objections during course of day.
It is reported that appellant has not complied office objections.
Hence, there is no other option than to conclude that appellant is not interested in pursuing this appeal.
Hence, appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.

Sd/-
